suggestion: Decide the price-data policy (P-01) before any backtest is published
options: (a) licensed historical odds feed; (b) operator data partnership; (c) manual signed snapshots recorded at fixed clock times
recommendation: (a) if budget allows - it is the only option that supports verifiable opening/closing numbers at scale; (c) as an interim with read-clock stamps
what_would_change_our_mind: Evidence that (b) or (c) can deliver timestamped open+close for every originated market with a verifiable audit trail

suggestion: Move the raw-data layer to private storage and keep the public site derived-only
options: (a) keep raw rows public; (b) private store + public derived indices/ratios; (c) publish only aggregates
recommendation: (b) matches the brief's public-analysis/private-data split and reduces terms risk on row-level data
what_would_change_our_mind: Confirmation that the terms of use permit publishing row-level official data publicly

suggestion: Replace one-off captures with a scheduled capture service (daily Wed-kickoff; pre-kickoff final)
options: (a) GitHub Actions cron hitting official endpoints; (b) external scheduler + artifact store; (c) keep manual session captures
recommendation: (a) is lowest-friction and keeps hashes in-repo; alert on row-count drift (drift alarm per scraper)
what_would_change_our_mind: Evidence that (b) is materially more reliable (retention / byte-level hashes) for the same effort

suggestion: Adopt a byte-level capture format (raw HTTP bytes + SHA-256) instead of processed-text extracts
options: (a) server-side fetch job storing response bytes; (b) accept processed-text with hashes of transcriptions; (c) PDF-first capture of Game Books
recommendation: (a) for the standing feeds (injuries/schedule/standings); (b) documented as an accepted limitation until then
what_would_change_our_mind: Confirmation that processed-text hashes have stood up in a dispute (they have not been tested)

suggestion: Publish a weekly 'what changed' diff (rank/rating/availability deltas) instead of static snapshots
options: (a) generated diff page per week; (b) inline delta columns on each table; (c) changelog text only
recommendation: (a)+(b) combined - the brief asks for a diff column and a published delta
what_would_change_our_mind: Evidence that consumers use the diff page more than the inline columns (usage review after 4 weeks)

suggestion: Run the leaderboard with control baselines (random picks; favorites-only) in every evaluation window
options: (a) always-on baselines; (b) baselines only at season end; (c) no baselines
recommendation: (a) - the brief requires removing luck; baselines are the cheapest control
what_would_change_our_mind: A demonstration that always-on baselines distort strategy behaviour (they should not)

suggestion: Build the per-team availability view (starters out; replacements named; net count) as the first team-level page
options: (a) per-team page driven by the availability register; (b) a single league matrix; (c) both
recommendation: (c) - teams view for decisions; matrix for scanning; both generated from one register
what_would_change_our_mind: Usage evidence that the matrix alone is sufficient

suggestion: Pre-register every strategy in git (definition text + sample window + gates) with the commit hash as the registration
options: (a) a registrations/ directory with frozen markdown; (b) registration rows inside the leaderboard CSV;(c) both
recommendation: (a) - immutable and reviewable; the hash IS the timestamp
what_would_change_our_mind: None - this is required by the brief; the only open question is file layout

suggestion: Keep backtest numbers off the leaderboard entirely (pre-registration wall)
options: (a) separate backtest page clearly labelled; (b) hide backtests until certification; (c) show on leaderboard greyed
recommendation: (a) - visibility without contamination; the leaderboard accepts only prospectively scored entries
what_would_change_our_mind: A reason to believe readers cannot distinguish backtest from prospective rows even when labelled

suggestion: Publish the model as probability + inputs for every output (never a bare pick)
options: (a) machine-readable output rows (prob + inputs + model version); (b) human tables only
recommendation: (a) with the human table generated from it
what_would_change_our_mind: None - required by the brief; open only on file format

suggestion: Add a demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper on a defined trigger
options: (a) lower confidence bound of Brier skill < 0 over N=50 scored games; (b) 3 consecutive losing weeks; (c) max drawdown breach
recommendation: (a) as the primary trigger with (c) as a hard stop - both proper-score/uncertainty based
what_would_change_our_mind: Evidence that a shorter window (30 games) reacts to genuine decay without over-trading on variance

suggestion: Fix the shared COORDINATION.md hygiene (leaked shell text; duplicated block) in a dedicated integration pass
options: (a) integration-session cleanup commit; (b) leave as-is and append; (c) regenerate the board from per-session blocks
recommendation: (a) during the next integration session - single-purpose commit
status: Nothing - cleanup is safe if it is content-preserving; review the diff line by line
